ruleBookInfo.author: $.data.author_name
ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
var candidates = [];
if (typeof bookUrl !== "undefined" && bookUrl) candidates.push(String(bookUrl));
if (typeof baseUrl !== "undefined" && baseUrl) candidates.push(String(baseUrl));
if (typeof book !== "undefined" && book && book.bookUrl) candidates.push(String(book.bookUrl));
if (typeof java !== "undefined" && java.ruleUrl) candidates.push(String(java.ruleUrl));
var currentUrl = "";
var match = null;
for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
  var candidateMatch = candidates[i].match(/\/book\/(\d+)(?:\/|$)/);
  if (candidateMatch) {
    currentUrl = candidates[i];
    match = candidateMatch;
    break;
  }
}
if (!match) {
  throw new Error("无法从书籍地址取得 book_id: " + candidates.join(" | "));
}
var siteBaseUrl = "https://www.lightnovel.fun/";
var securityRaw = cookie.getKey(siteBaseUrl, "lk_security_key");
var securityKey = "";
if (securityRaw !== null && securityRaw !== undefined && !/^\s*$/.test(String(securityRaw))) {
  var securityText = String(securityRaw);
  try {
    securityText = decodeURIComponent(securityText);
  } catch (e) {
    securityText = String(securityRaw);
  }
  securityKey = securityText;
  try {
    var securityData = JSON.parse(securityText);
    if (securityData && securityData.security_key) {
      securityKey = String(securityData.security_key);
    } else if (typeof securityData === "string") {
      securityKey = securityData;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // lk_security_key is normally stored as a plain string.
  }
}
var body = {
  book_id: match[1],
  with_volumes: 0,
  security_key: securityKey
};
var headers = {
  "Referer": siteBaseUrl,
  "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 6.0; Nexus 5 Build/MRA58N) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/141.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36",
  "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=UTF-8",
  "Cookie": cookie.getCookie(siteBaseUrl)
};
var detailText = java.post("https://www.lightnovel.fun/api/pc-proxy/api/new-content-read/get-book-detail", JSON.stringify(body), headers).body();
if (detailText === null || detailText === undefined || /^\s*$/.test(String(detailText))) {
  throw new Error("轻之国度详情接口返回空响应，请确认已登录、Cookie 未过期，并稍后重试");
}
src = String(detailText);
src;
</js>
